study-objective.zh: 我们评估／研究／旨在阐明
study-objective.use_when: 陈述实际研究问题，不预先写成已证明的结论。
study-objective.confusable: evaluate与validate不同；探索并不等于验证。
study-objective.safe_example: We evaluated the association between [factor] and [endpoint].
study-objective.unsafe_example: We validated the causal role of [factor].
study-objective.boundary: 必须与已实施设计和分析匹配。

analysis-population.zh: 可评价人群／分析集／分母
analysis-population.use_when: 区分入组、治疗、疗效可评价、标志物可评价及配对样本集。
analysis-population.unsafe_example: All enrolled patients contributed to every assay.
analysis-population.boundary: 每个终点单独锁定分母，缺失与剔除需有记录。

co-alteration.zh: 共突变／共改变／共同出现
co-alteration.use_when: 按实际变异类型及条件人群报告共同出现。
co-alteration.safe_example: [Gene A] co-occurred with [gene B] within [genotype-defined population].
co-alteration.unsafe_example: The genes cooperated biologically because they co-occurred.
co-alteration.boundary: 保留KRAS亚型等条件；不要把拷贝数缺失改写为点突变。

variant-function.zh: 功能缺失／致病性／蛋白缺失／等位基因状态
variant-function.use_when: 分别说明序列变异注释、拷贝数与蛋白实验结果。
variant-function.confusable: predicted loss-of-function、biallelic inactivation与IHC蛋白缺失并非同义。
variant-function.safe_example: Variants were classified using [annotation rule]; protein expression was evaluated separately.
variant-function.unsafe_example: Every nonsynonymous mutation abolished protein expression.
variant-function.boundary: 阈值与功能结论不能从另一基因移植。

adjusted-estimate.zh: 调整后／多变量模型／风险比
adjusted-estimate.use_when: 给出效应方向、参照组、协变量及区间。
adjusted-estimate.safe_example: The adjusted HR for [group] versus [reference] was [HR] (95% CI, [lower-upper]).
adjusted-estimate.boundary: 不凭HR数字猜参照方向；区间必须与点估计对应。

null-result.zh: 未达到统计学显著性／区间包含无效值
null-result.use_when: 如实报告未显著结果，同时保留估计值和不确定性。
null-result.confusable: 未显著不等于相同、等效或不存在关联。
null-result.safe_example: The estimate favored [group], but the confidence interval included the null.
null-result.unsafe_example: The treatments were equivalent because P exceeded 0.05.
null-result.boundary: 不要用trend包装失败的显著性检验；等效性需要相应设计。

interaction.zh: 交互作用／治疗效果预测性标志物
interaction.use_when: 区分组内关联与治疗间效果差异。
interaction.confusable: 一组显著另一组不显著，并不证明交互显著。
interaction.safe_example: Whether the association differed by treatment requires a treatment-by-biomarker interaction analysis.
interaction.unsafe_example: The biomarker predicted benefit because only one subgroup had P<0.05.
interaction.boundary: 预后标志物不能自动升级为治疗选择标志物。

endpoint-hierarchy.zh: 主要终点／探索性／事后分析
endpoint-hierarchy.use_when: 完整保留预设性、终点层级和多重比较处理。
endpoint-hierarchy.confusable: 预设次要终点不等于主要终点；事后亚组不等于确证。
endpoint-hierarchy.safe_example: The primary endpoint was not met; [finding] arose from an exploratory analysis.
endpoint-hierarchy.unsafe_example: The trial succeeded because an exploratory subgroup improved.
endpoint-hierarchy.boundary: 摘要与结论不能淡化阴性主要终点。

response-control.zh: 疾病控制／客观缓解／确认缓解
response-control.use_when: 说明缓解标准、确认要求和人群。
response-control.confusable: DCR包含的稳定疾病不能算成ORR；未确认与确认缓解不同。
response-control.safe_example: Disease control and confirmed objective response are reported separately.
response-control.unsafe_example: Disease control rate was the tumor response rate.
response-control.boundary: 中枢与全身终点、病灶与患者分母分别报告。

safety.zh: 不良事件／耐受性／毒性／安全性
safety.use_when: 区分全因与治疗相关、分级、严重事件、停药和死亡。
safety.confusable: serious与severe不同；没有观察到不等于排除风险。
safety.safe_example: [n/N] patients experienced grade [grade] treatment-related adverse events.
safety.unsafe_example: The treatment was safe despite unreported fatal events.
safety.boundary: 不能用manageable替代实际严重毒性数据。

bulk-deconvolution.zh: 反卷积／推断的免疫组成／bulk RNA测序
bulk-deconvolution.use_when: 明确计算推断来自混合组织数据。
bulk-deconvolution.confusable: 推断细胞比例不是单细胞实测比例。
bulk-deconvolution.safe_example: Bulk expression profiles were used to infer [cell signature] using [method].
bulk-deconvolution.unsafe_example: Single-cell sequencing demonstrated the cell proportions.
bulk-deconvolution.boundary: 算法输出不等于独立实验验证。

single-cell-unit.use_when: 保留物种、样本、患者和细胞层级及统计单位。
single-cell-unit.confusable: 细胞数不能当独立患者数；小鼠scRNA不是人类scRNA证据。
single-cell-unit.safe_example: Expression was aggregated by [patient/sample] for pseudobulk analysis.
single-cell-unit.unsafe_example: Thousands of cells represented thousands of independent patients.
single-cell-unit.boundary: 仅在实际使用时陈述伪bulk、批次校正或独立验证。

spatial-assay.use_when: 明确测量的是RNA、蛋白信号还是组织图像。
spatial-assay.confusable: 空间蛋白成像不是空间转录组；空间邻近不是直接相互作用。
spatial-assay.safe_example: Spatial proximity between [cell types] was quantified using [assay].
spatial-assay.unsafe_example: Neighboring cells were proven to signal directly.
spatial-assay.boundary: 共定位、富集、通讯推断与扰动验证分开。

proteomics.zh: 蛋白组学／逆相蛋白阵列／邻近延伸／液相色谱质谱
proteomics.use_when: 报告平台、覆盖、定量方法及QC后分析集合。
proteomics.confusable: 靶向面板、RPPA、流式不能直接叫无偏全蛋白组。
proteomics.safe_example: A targeted [N]-protein panel was analyzed; [n] proteins passed quality control.
proteomics.unsafe_example: A targeted panel comprehensively measured the entire proteome.
proteomics.boundary: label-free与TMT等来源冲突未解决前不能替作者选择。

cell-communication.zh: 细胞通讯推断／配体／受体／信号通路
cell-communication.use_when: 根据实际方法区分表达、评分、通路读出和直接干预。
cell-communication.confusable: 推断通讯不等于分泌实测；通路评分不等于生化活性。
cell-communication.safe_example: The analysis inferred [interaction], which requires experimental confirmation.
cell-communication.unsafe_example: The computation proved secretion and receptor activation.
cell-communication.boundary: 通路激活也不自动证明药物敏感性增加。

validation.zh: 外部验证／独立队列／交叉验证／训练
validation.use_when: 注明患者、中心、时间、拆分、调参及测试隔离。
validation.confusable: 内部随机拆分或交叉验证不是外部验证。
validation.safe_example: Performance was assessed in a held-out internal test set.
validation.unsafe_example: An internal random split established external generalizability.
validation.boundary: 不能因检索到模板就补造验证步骤。

model-performance.zh: 曲线下面积／区分度／临床效用／校准度
model-performance.use_when: 写清预测目标、时间窗、集合和不确定性。
model-performance.confusable: 区分度、校准度及临床效用不同；AUC不是生存C-index的通用替代词。
model-performance.safe_example: The model discriminated [outcome] in [test set], with an AUC of [value].
model-performance.boundary: 可迁移性与临床应用需额外证据。

perturbation.zh: 敲除／敲低／同基因背景／救援实验
perturbation.use_when: 说明模型、对照、扰动、重复和读出。
perturbation.confusable: 非同基因背景细胞系对比不能代替受控扰动；敲低不同于敲除。
perturbation.unsafe_example: Two unrelated cell lines established gene-specific causality.
perturbation.boundary: 机制证据的结论范围限于实际模型与干预。

drug-sensitivity.zh: 半数抑制浓度／药物敏感性／抗肿瘤活性
drug-sensitivity.use_when: 分清药物、浓度、时间、终点、模型与方向。
drug-sensitivity.confusable: IC50升高通常不是敏感性提高；体外活性不是患者获益。
drug-sensitivity.boundary: 来源曲线与正文矛盾时隔离方向性结论。

limitations.zh: 受……限制／局限性／混杂／回顾性
limitations.use_when: 说明具体限制影响哪项推断，而不是套用通用免责声明。
limitations.confusable: 翻译原文时不能默默补上作者未写的限制。
limitations.unsafe_example: All bias was excluded by multivariable adjustment.
limitations.boundary: 翻译正文与新增科学审查意见分开输出。

bounded-conclusion.zh: 值得进一步研究／支持进一步评估／提供研究依据
bounded-conclusion.use_when: 把结论限制到已有证据，并指向可验证的问题。
bounded-conclusion.confusable: supports evaluation不是supports immediate clinical adoption。
bounded-conclusion.safe_example: These findings support prospective evaluation of [hypothesis].
bounded-conclusion.unsafe_example: These findings establish a new standard of care.
bounded-conclusion.boundary: 阴性主要终点与探索性分析仍需明确保留。

figure-narrative.zh: 图表叙事：研究对象→比较→观察→边界
figure-narrative.use_when: 让每段与实际图表和分析集合对应。
figure-narrative.confusable: 图题可以概括观察，不能用推断机制替代图中测量。
figure-narrative.unsafe_example: The figure proves a mechanism not tested in the study.
figure-narrative.boundary: 参考论文提供组织方法，不授权补造本研究图表。

atm-truncating-estimate.restriction: Do not reuse the truncating-ATM HR 0.731 / CI 0.899–1.038 trio. KRAS-conditioned co-mutation and drug-specific experimental effects must remain separate from pooled associations.

smarca4-classes.restriction: SMARCA4 variant class, protein loss and STK11 co-occurrence are distinct. Retrospective ICI associations do not prove predictive benefit.

atm-null-context.restriction: Preserve overall null ICI findings and exploratory subgroup limits; pathogenicity, LOH and protein loss are not interchangeable.

g12v-denominators.restriction: Separate 636-patient molecular and 151-patient advanced-treatment cohorts; no STK11-specific causal or predictive treatment claim.

q61-conditioning.restriction: Do not pool Q61H–STK11 enrichment and Q61L–STK11 exclusivity into one all-Q61 statement.

ampratio-transfer.restriction: NSCLC STK11/EGFR amplification context is not STK11 treatment validation; HER2 outcome cohorts are other cancers. Do not transfer amplification cutoffs to STK11 deletion.

erbb2-adjustment.restriction: Adjusted ECD-versus-TKD PFS P=0.06 and CI includes 1; do not call it significant. Supplied PDF is pre-proof, not version of record.

durvalumab-figure4.restriction: Results prose and Figure 4 disagree on STK11/CDKN2A HR assignment. Figure4 is physical PDF p33. Physical p14 line282 says OS but Table2 physical p29 is a PFS model; do not transfer that OS label. Disclose conflicts for exact estimates. No non-durvalumab comparator. Supplied PDF is pre-proof.

stk11-copy-loss.restriction: Separate monoallelic deletion, biallelic inactivation, TCGA expression and treatment cohorts; preserve 19p co-deletion and ICI-alone heterogeneity.

mtap-not-stk11.restriction: Structural analogue only: no STK11/LKB1 analysis in supplied main text. MTAP copy number <0.6 is not an STK11 threshold.

cd2015-figure7.restriction: Expression clusters differ from mutation groups. p11 prose and Fig7D conflict on knockdown IC50 direction; reopen panel before a directional drug-sensitivity claim.

cd2018-source-conflict.restriction: Preserve response denominators, LKB1 protein versus mutation, small comparator uncertainty and unresolved source confidence-interval discrepancy. Reopen the article for exact estimates.

nature-union-contrast.restriction: STK11 and/or KEAP1 is a union, not double mutation. TDCT-versus-CT and TDCT-versus-DCT differ; the latter OS CI includes 1. Human bulk inference differs from mouse scRNA. PD-L1 denominator and other source conflicts remain bounded.

lpa-proteomics-conflict.restriction: Methods disagree on label-free versus TMT protein quantification; do not select either as resolved. CellChat/c4 LPA secretion is inferred, not directly measured. Internal split is not external validation.

genomics2025-39804166.restriction: Shorter STK11-mutant survival does not imply lower ORR: both groups45%. NRF2/OS in KEAP1WT is nonsignificant. Figure4A drug label differs from caption. Clinical associations are not predictive interactions; combinations are preclinical.

genomics2025-39932457.restriction: Patient prevalence and all-call/somatic-call CH proportions have different denominators. Figure1 classification direction and Figure2C mean/median labels conflict with prose. Do not implement the algorithm from this source alone.

genomics2025-40704901.restriction: Thoracic NUT carcinoma is not interchangeable with all NSCLC. Assay sensitivity requires modality-specific coverage denominators; no significant survival difference by detection modality. BRD4 exon and calendar labels differ across source locations.

genomics2025-40388547.restriction: NCI-MATCH concordance concerns shared genes and actionable entry alterations, not entire profiles. Table2 sarcoma CI does not contain its estimate. Negative plasma does not exclude tissue-defined response.

genomics2025-39437011.restriction: Observational treatment interaction is not randomized predictive validation. Low-volume PFS P values and FDR notation conflict within source. Olink targeted proteins are not mass-spectrometry whole-proteome data.

genomics2025-39887260.restriction: RET-positive-only sample selection cannot estimate clinical specificity. Abstract QC denominators conflict with Results; rescue analyses are unblinded/post hoc and not primary assay sensitivity.

genomics2025-40310449.restriction: VISION tissue/liquid groups overlap. Between-biopsy efficacy comparisons are descriptive without formal P values. Any-variant ctDNA detectability differs from METex14 positivity; tumor burden confounds comparisons.

genomics2025-39853318.restriction: Updated same261-patient MRD cohort is not external validation. Negative MRD is not proof of cure or absence of adjuvant benefit. Figure3C HR/CI conflict and invalid prose P value must not be reused.

genomics2025-40261185.restriction: ctMoniTR landmark/internal test split is not external validation or trial-level surrogate validation. Preserve persistent-versus-clearance reference direction and endpoint-specific denominators. Table1 totals differ from subgroup sums.

genomics2025-40465842.restriction: Lung-MAP Figure6 caption CI lower bound conflicts with plot/Results; Figure2 color labels conflict. High tumor fraction improves some detection while marking poorer prognosis, not treatment prediction. CNA sensitivity remains limited.

genomics2025-40047548.restriction: Quantified ADC target abundance is not demonstrated ADC efficacy. Unknown EGFR status is not wild type. Analytical LOD/LOQ is not a clinical response cutoff; protein calibration is targeted, not discovery proteomics.

genomics2025-39836411.restriction: RAS-RAF PLA is pan-RAS proximity, not KRASG12C-specific binding. Small treated-only cohort and optimized cutoff do not validate treatment selection. Table1 sex/year percentages conflict with counts; external co-mutation cohort is not this study.

genomics2025-39620930.restriction: DIAMOND all-model methylation validation sensitivity41% at99%specificity differs from combined91% at93%. Cancer-specific experts are not tissue-origin classifiers. Lung validation has8 metastatic cases; no early-lung screening validation.
